title: A Faster Way to Find Hidden Pulsars in NASA Fermi Data
paragraphs: A pulsar is a star that spins very fast. It sends out light like a lighthouse. Scientists want to find more pulsars.
A team of scientists made a new way to look for pulsars. They used 15 years of data from a NASA space telescope. The telescope is called Fermi.
They found one new pulsar. It spins 261 times in one second. The computer needed only about 10 hours. Scientists say the new way is much faster.
